conclusion: The cover lemma gives a useful sufficient branch, but the naive derived quasi-rack route is not yet a theorem for all degenerate solutions.  The next decisive test is a size-four or larger degenerate non-involutive table outside the quasi-left-nondegenerate subclass.

proof_steps: A surjective solution morphism pi:Z->X makes pi^n:Z^n->X^n B_n-equivariant and surjective.
Therefore ker rho^Z_n <= ker rho^X_n for every n.
By the left-nondegenerate derived/guitar theorem, some finite rack Y has ker rho^Y_n <= ker rho^Z_n for every n.
Transitivity gives ker rho^Y_n <= ker rho^X_n for every n.
cover_lemma.statement: If a finite YBE solution X is a homomorphic image of a finite left-nondegenerate solution Z, then X is dominated by a finite rack.
cover_lemma.status: sufficient but not known to be necessary
